name: role-prompt-contract-measurement-baseline
title: Story 1: establish role-prompt contracts and a no-output-drift measurement baseline
description: Implement Story 1 of the accepted role-prompt modularization plan: add versioned Runtime Contract, Role Contract, Prompt Envelope, and PromptMeasurementRecord structures; mechanically freeze the 16-role lifecycle matrix; and expose reproducible prompt-cost measurements while preserving every existing agent_prompt output byte-for-byte. This Story records measurement sidecars only and must not create Story-bound Prompt Envelopes or change dispatch behavior.
